items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And so we were going to take a trip down in Virginia... but it was Dick Carey and Al Hall and Jimmy Crawford, Ray Deal and Max and myself.

ctx.x: You know, we had a band one time through the -- and I think -- I don't know what years it was, but it was in the '40s or '50s or something like that, and it was Max Kaminsky's band, Dixieland band. And they had Dick Carey on piano.
Did he double on peck horn?
